source_scope.horizontal_pair: All Boolean words, right multiplication; endpoint offset true-letter count.
source_scope.vertical_pair: All Boolean words ending true, left multiplication/right-to-left induction; endpoint offset word length.
source_scope.actual_support: Every source path and every natural slice index, both coordinate residuals; interval support with zero extension.
source_scope.zero_slice_iff: Residual polynomial R_r equals zero iff its slice index r>a+b-1.
source_scope.nonzero_slice_degree: Horizontal a+j and vertical b+i when slice index <=a+b-1.
source_scope.leading_coefficients: Horizontal choose(d,d-j), vertical choose(d,i), with d=a+b-1 and slice index<=d.
source_scope.conditional_horizontal_transfer: 2*j+1<=b AND all natural adjacent inequalities for horizontal residual row j.
source_scope.conditional_vertical_transfer: 2*i+1<=a AND all natural adjacent inequalities for vertical residual column i.
source_scope.high_factorization: Residual=(1+X)^(2*r+1-opposite_source_index)*raw slice in the opposite inequality range, including equality; no reverse LC cancellation.

notes: All exact theorem statements are preserved above. Auxiliary support/PairGood hypotheses are discharged by actual-word recurrences, while adjacent-LC hypotheses in the two raw-transfer theorems remain explicit.
Support and leading/degree results alone do not assert residual or raw LC.
Natural subtraction in raw degree bounds is distinct from residual degree equalities, which require slice<=d.
